read.thesis: Clean 1Q26 beat with NII up 9% to $15.7B, efficiency ratio 61% and operating leverage 2.9%, but credit card charge-offs are seasonal and the balance sheet grew loans 9% with no supply-side signal.

triggers.label: NII up 9% to $15.7B
triggers.quote: Net Interest Income Grew 9% YoY to $15.7 Billion ($15.9 Billion FTE)

triggers.label: Loans up 9% YoY to $1.19T
triggers.quote: Average loans and leases of $1.19 trillion increased 9%, with growth across every business segment

triggers.label: Net charge-off ratio 0.48% vs 0.54%
triggers.quote: Net charge-off ratio2 of 0.48% decreased 6 bps vs. 1Q25 and increased 4 bps vs. 4Q25
